The `<table name>.list` shortcut opens a table’s list view. Therefore, `sys_user.list` displays the records in the Users (`sys_user`) table. [ServiceNow: Navigate directly to a table](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-user-interface/t_NavigateDirectlyToATable.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Navigate directly to a table](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-user-interface/t_NavigateDirectlyToATable.html)

question: Which tool lets you have real-time conversations with logged-in users?
explanation:
ServiceNow Connect Chat is a real-time messaging tool that lets users chat with individuals and groups, supporting direct and group conversations.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Connect Chat](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/servicenow-platform/connect/c_Collaboration.html)

question: Which flow components let you specify when a flow runs?
explanation:
In ServiceNow Flow Designer, a trigger specifies when a flow starts, while conditions determine when actions run or refine the circumstances under which processing occurs.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Workflow Studio: Getting started with flows](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/build-workflows/workflow-studio/getting-started-flow.html) · [ServiceNow Workflow Studio: Flows](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/build-workflows/workflow-studio/exploring-flows.html)

question: Which module lets an administrator define destinations for imported data on any ServiceNow table?
explanation:
A Transform Map specifies how fields from an import-set table map to fields in a target ServiceNow table, thereby defining the destination for imported data. [ServiceNow: Transform maps](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/integrate-applications/system-import-sets/c_CreatingNewTransformMaps.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Transform maps](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/integrate-applications/system-import-sets/c_CreatingNewTransformMaps.html)

question: Regarding ServiceNow reporting, which of the following statements explains what a metric can do?

options.label: A
options.text: A metric is a report gauge used on homepages to display real-time data

options.label: B
options.text: A metric is a time measurement used to report the effectiveness of workflows and SLAs

options.label: C
options.text: A metric is used to measure and evaluate the effectiveness of IT service management processes

options.label: D
options.text: A metric is a comparative measurement used to report the effectiveness of flows and SLAs.

explanation:
A ServiceNow metric can track the duration for which an audited field holds a particular value, such as how long an incident remains assigned to a person or stays active. These time measurements support reporting on the effectiveness of workflows and SLAs.

**Learn more:** [Timing functionality](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/time-configuration/c_TimingFunctionality.html) · [Define a metric](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/create-metric.html)

question: What is one key distinction between Reporting and Performance Analytics?

options.label: A
options.text: Performance Analytics contains snapshots of data taken over time; Reporting shows only the data as it is, at the moment the report is run.

options.label: B
options.text: Performance Analytics can show trends; Reports cannot.

options.label: C
options.text: Reports can be run on a scheduled basis; Performance Analytics cannot.

options.label: D
options.text: Performance Analytics data can be published to Dashboards; Reports cannot.

options.label: E
options.text: Performance Analytics shows KPIs; Reporting does not.

explanation:
Performance Analytics captures indicator scores and snapshots at regular intervals, creating historical data that supports accurate trend analysis. Reporting generally queries and displays the current state of table data at the time it runs.

**Learn more:** [Reporting compared to Performance Analytics](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/now-intelligence/reporting/reporting-vs-pa.html) · [Performance Analytics concepts](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/now-intelligence/performance-analytics/c_PerformanceAnalytics.html)

question: Which ServiceNow capability lets you deliver knowledge articles through a conversational messaging interface?
explanation:
ServiceNow Virtual Agent provides automated user assistance through an intelligent messaging interface and supports self-service access to information such as Knowledge articles.

**Learn more:** [Exploring Virtual Agent](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/conversational-interfaces/virtual-agent/exploring-virtual-agent.html?contentId=5ABaifUBvfYGiBsXDBu6wA) · [Case and incident deflection in Virtual Agent](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/conversational-interfaces/virtual-agent/case-incident-deflection-virtual-agent.html)

question: From which different locations in the platform can reports be created? (select 2)
explanation:
ServiceNow supports creating a report directly from a list’s column-heading menu, which starts a chart/report using that list data. Reports can also be created from the **Reports > View / Run** module, where the Reports list provides a creation action.

**Learn more:** [View the Reports list](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/de-DE/now-intelligence/reporting/r_ViewTheReportsList.html?contentId=4aTa8NzahiMgwaMUhtvIUw) · [View demo data](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/servicenow-platform/metricbase/getting-familiar-with-metricbase.html?contentId=mQu2cnhEk6Gh2IF1CznBYg)

question: Which single statement correctly describes how Access Control rules are evaluated?

options.label: A
options.text: Table access rules are evaluated from the general to the specific

options.label: B
options.text: If more than one rule applies to a record, the older rule is evaluated first

options.label: C
options.text: If a row level rule and a field level rule exist, both rules must be true before an operation is allowed

options.label: D
options.text: The role with the most permissions evaluates the rules first.

explanation: $aa

question: Which actions are needed to narrow the number of records shown in a list view?

options.label: A
options.text: Add embedded lists and form annotations

options.label: B
options.text: Select the filter icon and apply conditions

options.label: C
options.text: Modify field properties and duplicate form views

explanation:
List filters restrict the records displayed by applying conditions. Selecting the filter icon opens the condition builder, where conditions can be defined and applied to the list. [Create a filter in List](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-user-interface/t_CreatingFilters.html)

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Create a filter in List](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-user-interface/t_CreatingFilters.html)

question: When choosing a Target table for an import, which tables are available to select? (select 3)

options.label: D
options.text: Tables which allow write access to other applications

options.label: E
options.text: Tables within the existing application scope

explanation:
An import maps staged data into a ServiceNow target table. The selectable targets include tables in the current application scope, tables in the global scope, and cross-scope tables that permit write access from other applications. Application access settings control whether other scopes can access a table and perform write operations.

**Learn more:** [Application access settings](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/application-development/c_ApplicationAccessSettings.html) · [Table design and runtime settings](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/application-development/r_TableApplicationAccessFields.html)

question: Which feature enables a critical, high-priority service request to be automatically allocated to the appropriate assignment group or team member?
explanation:
Assignment Rules apply configured conditions to task records and automatically populate the assigned user and/or assignment group. A rule can therefore route critical, high-priority service requests to the appropriate team or member.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Assignment rules module](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/table-administration-and-data-management/c_AssignmentRulesModule.html)

question: Which role most commonly has access to nearly all platform features, functions, and data?
explanation:
The ServiceNow System Administrator role (`admin`) has access to all system features, functions, and data because it can override access-control-list rules and pass role checks. The `security_admin` role is an elevated privilege focused on access controls and High Security Settings, not the general full-platform administrator role.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Base system roles](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/user-administration/r_BaseSystemRoles.html) · [ServiceNow: Security_admin role](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-security/security-admin-role.html)

question: Which of the following steps can be used to import new data into ServiceNow from a spreadsheet?

options.label: B
options.text: Load Data, Create Transform Map, Run Transform

options.label: C
options.text: Define Data Source, Select Transform Map, Run Transform

options.label: D
options.text: Select Import Set, Select Transform Map, Run Transform

explanation: A spreadsheet import in ServiceNow is loaded into an import set, mapped to a target table with a transform map, and then transformed to create or update records.

question: What is the recommended practice for using the Default Update Set when moving customizations between instances?

options.label: A
options.text: Merge Default update sets before moving between instances

options.label: B
options.text: Submit Default update set to application repository

options.label: C
options.text: You should not use the Default Update sets for moving between instances

options.label: D
options.text: Keep Default update set to maximum of 20 records, for troubleshooting purposes

explanation:
The global default update set supports system functionality and should not be changed, deleted, or moved between systems. Use a separately created update set to capture and transfer customizations between instances.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Default update set](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/application-development/system-update-sets/default-update-sets.html) · [ServiceNow: Working with update sets](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/application-development/system-update-sets/using-system-update-sets.html)

question: When a flow executes an action, it creates a runtime value that remains unchanged for the flow's duration. What is this runtime value called?
explanation: A data pill is the Flow Designer representation of a runtime value generated by a trigger or action. Its value is available for use by later flow steps during that flow execution.

question: When working with Flow Designer, what initiates Flow Execution?
explanation: A Flow Designer flow execution starts when its configured trigger fires. Triggers define the event or condition that launches a flow.

question: What is an Import Set Table?

options.label: A
options.text: A table where data will be placed, post-transformation

options.label: C
options.text: A staging area for imported records

options.label: D
options.text: A repository for Update Set information

explanation: An Import Set Table is a staging table that holds imported records before they are transformed and loaded into target tables.

question: Which setting lets users view a Knowledge Base article without logging in?
explanation:
The Public setting permits unauthenticated users to access Knowledge Management Service Portal pages and view knowledge articles when the applicable knowledge-base read access is also configured for public users.

**Learn more:** [Enable external or public users to view knowledge articles from the Knowledge Management Service Portal](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/servicenow-platform/knowledge-management/make-knowledge-visible-to-public.html)

question: Buttons, form links, and context menu items are all examples of which type of functionality?
explanation:
In ServiceNow, UI Actions provide controls such as form buttons, related links, and form or list context-menu items.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: UI actions](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/c_UIActions.html?contentId=O5VhPOzlmtsfIWzc3NO23g)

question: What is a fast way to create a report from a list view?

options.label: A
options.text: Click on filter breadcrumb, drag and drop on the Report > Create New module

options.label: B
options.text: Click Funnel, define filter conditions, click Create Report

options.label: C
options.text: Click Context Menu, select Create Report

options.label: D
options.text: Apply filter, right click on column header, select Bar Chart

options.label: E
options.text: Apply filter, right click on column header, select Create Report

explanation:
The fastest way to generate a report straight from a list is to apply your filter, right-click (or click the drop-down arrow on) a column header, and choose Bar Chart or Pie Chart; ServiceNow instantly builds a quick report grouped by that column, which you can then refine on the report screen. The column context menu offers 'Bar Chart' and 'Pie Chart' as the quick-report options, so D is correct. There is no 'Create Report' item in that column menu, which makes option E incorrect.

**Learn more:** [What is a quick way to create a report from a list view](https://www.freecram.net/question/ServiceNow.CSA.v2024-04-01.q187/what-is-a-quick-way-to-create-a-report-from-a-list-view) · [Report types from right-clicking a column header](https://www.exam4training.com/which-report-types-can-be-created-by-right-clicking-on-a-column-header-in-a-tables-list/)

question: For Access Control Definitions, which methods can be used to set permissions on a table? (select 3)

options.label: D
options.text: Script that sets the answer variable to true or false

explanation:
ServiceNow ACLs define access requirements using required roles, data conditions (conditional expressions), and scripts that evaluate to a Boolean value or set the `answer` variable to `true` or `false`. CRUD denotes the table operation being protected, while groups are not themselves an ACL requirement type.

**Learn more:** [Explore Access Control Lists](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-security/access-control/exploring-access-control-list.html) · [Available script types](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/api-reference/scripts/r_17Scripts.html)

question: Which table stores user records?
explanation: ServiceNow stores user account records in the User table, whose database name is `sys_user`.

question: Which policies apply to all data entered into the platform, such as through a record form (UI), Import Sets, or Web Services?
explanation:
ServiceNow Data Policies enforce data consistency by setting field states such as mandatory or read-only across data-entry methods. They apply to records submitted through the UI and can also apply to data received through import sets and web services.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow Data policy](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/c_DataPolicy.html?contentId=bkk032GHpRWxBckoW_~lZA) · [ServiceNow Data policy fields](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/r_DataPolicyFields.html?contentId=I3oJOsCNRk0lW_4vQQpquw)

question: Which script can be executed when a record is displayed, inserted, updated, or deleted, or when a table is queried?
explanation:
A ServiceNow Business Rule is a server-side script that can run when a record is displayed, inserted, updated, or deleted, or when a table is queried.

**Learn more:** [Classic Business rules](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/application-development/business-rules-classic/c_BusinessRules.html?contentId=Dmztln6libKSteD_kFexHQ)

question: For Administrators who create new Service Catalog items, what characteristic should they understand about Service Catalog variables?

options.label: A
options.text: Service Catalog variables can only be used in Record Producers

options.label: B
options.text: Service Catalog variables can only be used in Order Guides

options.label: C
options.text: Service Catalog variables cannot affect the order price

options.label: D
options.text: Service Catalog variables are global by default

explanation:

question: In a list, what is displayed in each row?
explanation: Each row in a list represents one individual record. Fields are typically displayed as columns within that record’s row.

question: An Administrator needs to review every user with privileged access to identify those who no longer require that level of access. Which Security Center feature can help meet this requirement?
explanation:
The Security posture console provides visibility into active privileged accounts, enabling administrators to review privileged users and assess whether their elevated access remains necessary. Security hardening measures configuration compliance, Security scanner identifies configuration findings, and Customer Actions presents remediation recommendations.

**Learn more:** [Security posture dashboards](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-security/security-center/scc-sec-posture-dashboard.html)

question:
A user wants to create filter conditions to display records that meet these two requirements:

- Incidents with a state of Closed
- Incidents whose Assignment Group is Network

After selecting the Funnel icon, what should the user do?

options.label: A
options.text: Define the first condition; click AND button; define second condition; click Run

options.label: B
options.text: Define the first condition; click AND button; define second condition; press enter

options.label: C
options.text: Define the first condition; click OR button; define second condition; press enter

options.label: D
options.text: Define the first condition; click > icon on breadcrumb, define second condition; click Run

options.label: E
options.text: Define the first condition; click > icon on breadcrumb, define second condition; press enter

explanation:
An AND connector requires every linked condition to be true, so it returns only incidents that are both Closed and assigned to the Network group. The ServiceNow list condition builder applies the completed filter when the user selects Run. Breadcrumb separators are for removing conditions, not adding another filter condition.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Filters](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-user-interface/c_Filters.html) · [ServiceNow: Create a filter in List](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-user-interface/t_CreatingFilters.html)

question: On the form header, which icon is used to access form templates?
explanation:
In ServiceNow, the **More options** icon in a form header provides access to **Toggle Template Bar**, which opens the template bar containing available form templates. The paperclip icon is for record attachments.

**Learn more:** [ServiceNow: Toggle the template bar](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-administration/t_ToggleTheTemplateBar.html?contentId=UMatdXi_eEKufIJZ~jk8lQ) · [ServiceNow: Form headers for UI versions](https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/platform-user-interface/form-header-by-version.html)

question: Which options can be configured to determine when a Business Rule executes? (select 4)
explanation:
